subject.title: fix(slack): add 30s timeout to directory client API calls

question: Should the real-WebClient local transport tests plus successful live Slack calls satisfy the proof gate, or must the contributor provide an exact-head stalled-request and 429 timing transcript?
rationale: The code and integration-style tests support the behavior, but the external-PR proof contract normally requires observed after-fix runtime output for the changed failure path.

options.title: Require failure-path transcript
options.body: Ask for redacted elapsed-time output from the exact head showing a stalled request timing out and a 429 response returning promptly.

options.title: Approve proof override
options.body: Accept the real-WebClient local server tests and successful live Slack calls as sufficient maintainer-owned proof for this narrow transport-policy change.

recommendation.title: Require failure-path transcript
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted elapsed-time output from the exact head showing a stalled request timing out and a 429 response returning promptly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current policy commits, are assigned to the PR, and are best positioned to confirm the intended operational contract.
